finding: After presenting distinct reports identifying al-As ibn Wa'il, Uqba ibn Abi Mu'ayt, and a group of Quraysh, Tabari states his own preferred conclusion: the verse describes the hater of the Messenger as lesser and abased, cut off in posterity; this is a description of anyone who hates him, even if revelation concerned a particular person. Keep this authorial preference separate from the preceding transmitted identifications.

review_scope.translation_proposal: The soundest view, in my judgment, is that God has informed us that the one who hates God's Messenger is the lesser and more abased, cut off in posterity. This describes everyone who hates him, even if the verse was revealed concerning a particular person.
review_scope.preservation: Do not rewrite Tabari's conclusion as a claim that the verse had no specific occasion; his wording expressly allows for a particular person.
